verdict.rationale: a-Shell supports some event-driven automation: it runs `.profile` automatically when a new window opens, and it integrates with Apple Shortcuts allowing users to build automations that invoke a-Shell commands. However there is no evidence of an internal rule engine for defining arbitrary triggers/conditions and actions within the app itself. Missing for 10: a native rules/trigger system, documented event types beyond window-open, and evidence of complex conditional automation.
